method.alignment: Integer bulk delay from full-signal absolute cross-correlation; left channel
method.primary_weighting: Equal weight per FFT frequency bin (linear Hz)
method.shape_normalization: Subtract the mean native-minus-reference dB offset before RMSE
method.ripple: RMS and p95-p05 of log-frequency magnitude minus Gaussian trend, sigma=1/6 octave
method.scope: Finite-window response at one white-noise level; does not establish nonlinear or transient equivalence

native_85_vs_100_plateau.scope: Depth0 comparison of native85% and100%; a zero waveform difference indicates a plateau.
